notes: Card knowledge and data (v2.4): cards now carry a Related block under the example - the word family is worked out from the bundled deck offline (create / creation / creative), and similar / opposite / related words come from Datamuse, cached with the meanings and refreshed after 30 days; tapping any chip looks that word up on the spot. Data & settings gains Export CSV (spreadsheet, UTF-8 BOM), Export for Anki (tab separated, three columns) and Import CSV / TSV that reads our own export, an Anki export or a plain word list, only ever filling in blanks; the sheet also says when you last exported and nudges once after 30 days without one.
